caption: The video captures a man wearing glasses and a white striped shirt, viewed from behind and to the right, using a brush to write large Chinese characters in black ink on a long horizontal sheet of white paper mounted on a gray textured wall. A carved dark wooden bar lies vertically along the left edge of the paper, while two small round objects hang on the wall above. The rightmost and middle characters are already fully formed and remain unchanged, while the leftmost character is actively being written. The brush tip stays within the leftmost character's area, progressively depositing new ink strokes, so the glyph grows from a few top strokes into a denser stack of short horizontal strokes. A long bottom horizontal stroke on the leftmost character extends rightward across the sequence, with the brush moving along it and an upward tick becoming visible at its right end in later frames. The man's wrist, hand, and forearm shift and rotate modestly as the strokes are laid down, while his head tilts slightly. The background elements remain fixed throughout, and the writing motion appears continuous.
